_readme: Every business fact on the site comes from this file. Anything starting with TODO shows highlighted on the site and is listed when you run build.py. Run `python3 build.py --production` before going live: it refuses to build while any TODO is left.
legal_line: TODO: Landlord Safety First is a trading name of [company name], registered in England & Wales no. [number]
tagline: Landlord safety certificates in East London
team_size_line: a two-person team: the engineer who books you is the engineer who turns up
cert_turnaround: TODO: confirm. Certificates emailed within 24 hours
slot_confirm_line: TODO: confirm. We confirm your slot within 2 working hours
payment_line: TODO: confirm. Pay by card when your slot is confirmed. Remedial work is paid on completion.
_scope_note: Before launch, confirm the engineer personally holds the right accreditation for EPCs (Domestic Energy Assessor) and fire risk assessments. If anything is done by a partner, change the 'no subcontractors' line in content.py and the EPC / FRA pages.
epc_scope: TODO: confirm EPCs are done by an accredited Domestic Energy Assessor in-house
fra_scope: TODO: confirm the engineer is a competent fire risk assessor, and which property types
_photo_note: Put a real photo of the engineer (and van) in src/static/ and set the file name here, e.g. "engineer.webp". Until then the hero shows an example certificate pack instead of a stock photo.
response_promise: TODO: confirm. We reply to every enquiry within 2 working hours
_prices_note: All prices are ex-VAT 'from' prices. The site shows them including VAT with the ex-VAT figure alongside. ALL ARE PLACEHOLDERS — confirm every one with the client. Nothing is sold below minimum_ex on its own: cheaper items are add-ons to another visit.

hourly.label: Electrical work, per hour
hourly.note: One-hour minimum, then charged per half hour

eicr_hmo_room.label: EICR, HMO
eicr_hmo_room.note: Added per lettable room on top of the house price

eicr_commercial.label: EICR, small commercial unit
eicr_commercial.note: Shops and offices, quoted by circuit count

gas_safety.label: Gas safety certificate (CP12)
gas_safety.note: Boiler plus up to 2 gas appliances

boiler_service.label: Boiler service
boiler_service.note: Added to a gas safety check. On its own the minimum visit applies

consumer_unit.label: Consumer unit replacement
consumer_unit.note: Up to 8 ways, including certificate and Building Regs notification

fire_alarm_test.label: Fire alarm test and certificate
fire_alarm_test.note: Small HMO or house, to BS 5839-6

emergency_lighting.label: Emergency lighting test
emergency_lighting.note: Annual 3-hour test and certificate, small HMO

epc.label: EPC (energy certificate)
epc.note: Added to another visit. On its own the minimum visit applies

pat.label: PAT testing
pat.note: Up to 10 appliances, added to another visit

alarm_check.label: Smoke and CO alarm check
alarm_check.note: Added to another visit. Fitting priced separately

picker._note: Instant price picker. A string value means 'use that key from prices'. Certificates marked cert:true count towards the bundle saving. Totals never go below minimum_ex.

bundles.name: Essentials
bundles.blurb: The two certificates the law asks every gas-heated rental for, in one visit.

bundles.name: Full Compliance
bundles.blurb: Everything a single let needs before a tenant moves in, with one renewal date to remember.

bundles.name: HMO / Commercial
bundles.blurb: Full Compliance plus the fire safety paperwork HMO licences ask for.

_booking_note: Optional. Paste a GoHighLevel / Cal.com / Calendly booking URL to embed it on /book/. Leave empty to use the built-in booking request form.
_form_note: Paste a GoHighLevel inbound webhook, n8n webhook, Formspree or Web3Forms URL. Every form POSTs JSON with a form_type of quote, booking or reminder. Leave empty and the forms tell people to call instead.
_reviews_note: Add real reviews only, with permission, e.g. {"name": "Sarah K.", "area": "Hackney", "text": "...", "service": "EICR"}. Review sections stay hidden until this list has entries.
